criterion: Creates a Markdown implementation plan under docs/plans/ (or presents a complete plan targeting docs/plans/) without modifying source files in walletcore/.
References walletcore/ledger.py (WalletLedger, TransferRequest, TransferReceipt) and tests/test_ledger.py by their exact names.

Specifies idempotency-key handling: returning the original TransferReceipt when the same key and parameters are re-submitted, and rejecting requests that reuse an idempotency key with different transfer parameters.
Specifies validation that prevents negative balances on debit accounts and ensures multi-leg transfers either apply all legs atomically or roll back completely on any leg failure.
Lists concrete unit test cases in tests/ covering duplicate idempotency replay, conflicting payload rejection, overdraft rejection, and atomic multi-leg rollback.
